text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
per cent per annum, having been fully recovered, as cer-
tified in accordance with the provisions of Act No. 3500,
as amended, it is hereby ordered that the collection of tolls
at the Sabang (Mauban) Toll Bridge be terminated.
This Order shall take effect upon receipt of copy hereof
by the Provincial Treasurer of Quezon.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the eighth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Frilippines
4731
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretaïy
